top_signals.title: India’s Small Traders Lose $9.6 Billion in Options Despite Curbs
top_signals.summary: Indian retail traders lost 916.85 billion rupees ($9.6 billion) trading equity futures and options in the year ended March, showing that a regulatory clampdown has so far had only limited success in stemming the heavy losses incurred by individual investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: How war shaped the manga of Tadao Tsuge
top_signals.summary: The "gekiga" pioneer drew on memories of war, hunger and poverty to chronicle Japan's overlooked lives.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
